issue.title: Remove the private just install forwarding alias from the four plugin repos after one release
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1ig.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by the sase-1ig land agent.

task_type_fields.proposal:
Remove the deprecated `[private] install` forwarding alias from the Justfiles of sase-github, sase-telegram, sase-research-artifacts, and sase-listen once each repo has shipped one release that includes its `install-venv` rename.

Each alias sits under the comment "Private alias kept for one release; remove after the next release." It prints "`just install` is now `just install-venv`" to stderr and then runs `just install-venv`. They were added by sase-1ig.7 in these commits:
- sase-github 69e1b0a, already released in 0.2.21
- sase-telegram 7f5a4b1, already released in 0.4.28
- sase-research-artifacts 555a0ad, release PR 0.3.1 pending as of 2026-10-09
- sase-listen 1b82d27, release PR 0.1.2 pending as of 2026-10-09

For each repo that has released, delete the alias recipe and its comment, and remove the alias test (sase-telegram tests/test_justfile.py:204 dry-runs `install`). Then grep the repo for any remaining `just install` caller (CI `run:` steps, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, README, CONTRIBUTING) and run that repo's check lane. Leave `install-source-sase` untouched.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1ig plan made alias removal "after one release" each plugin repo's own follow-up. It cannot happen inside sase-1ig, because two of the four repos have not released the rename yet.
